evidence.reason: The current publish code still builds a title cache keyed by (repo, pr) for every prior pending item, including items whose pr is None or non-int, then applies that lookup to every current item before the guarded gh fallback. Because PR-less rows in one repo all share (repo, None), a title-less PR-less item can inherit another row's cached title, producing a wrong published preview label. The proposed guard matches the existing positive-int PR guard and fixes an existing behavior defect.
